name: the-band-runs-from-one-colour-to-the-next
description: A page whose left edge is blue on top and red below gives the sampler a run of two colours on that edge, and the window logs the run as varied. The sidebar's own column, away from the band, holds the space tint: its mean stays the same as with ambilight off, which the band's colour would move if it flooded the backdrop as it used to.

assertions.label: the-left-edge-carries-two-colours
assertions.desc: The sampler read a run whose ends differ.

assertions.label: the-sidebar-column-keeps-the-space-tint
assertions.desc: The rows' column, well away from the band, reads the same light space tint the ambilight-off runs read (about 169,178,185). A backdrop flooded with the page's blue or red reads far darker here.
